##### Project general facts

Oceara Park View Residences Phase 1 stands as an exceptional boutique mid‑rise enclave comprising sixty‑three residences that blend one‑ to three‑bedroom apartments with three‑ to four‑bedroom townhouses for contemporary living. The design celebrates openness, employing layered terraces that spill outward, maximize daylight and generate natural shade, while expansive balconies frame uninterrupted park and coastal panoramas. Integrated greenery weaves through the façades, reinforcing a seamless dialogue between architecture and the surrounding landscape.

Residents are welcomed by a stunning infinity pool that mirrors the horizon, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium outfitted with Technogym machinery for peak performance. A tranquil yoga enclave, an indoor children’s play area, and meticulously landscaped pocket gardens provide niches for relaxation and family enjoyment. Complementary amenities feature a barbecue pavilion with alfresco dining, an elegant residents’ lobby with lounge seating, and a podium‑level playground designed for youthful adventure.

Interiors echo the sea’s soul through a refined palette of soothing blues, verdant greens and warm beiges that capture waterfront calm, parkland vibrancy and coastal texture. Every home benefits from a water softener, integrated fan‑coil air purification, a smart entry system for effortless security, a food‑waste disposer that streamlines kitchen hygiene, and a branded touch‑up kit that preserves finish quality long after move‑in.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands, a visionary assemblage of five man‑made islands, stretches along the coast to offer a blend of residential, commercial and leisure realms framed by pristine beaches and crystal‑clear waters. Its strategic positioning ensures that residents can glide from the serenity of island life to the dynamic pulse of the city with just a short drive, thanks to well‑developed infrastructure linking the mainland. Iconic destinations such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah sit within easy reach, providing access to world‑renowned attractions and vibrant urban districts.

The development’s internal landscape showcases upscale hotels, gourmet dining venues and high‑end retail outlets that cater to discerning tastes and social pursuits. Green spaces and advanced sustainability measures are woven throughout, promoting an eco‑friendly environment that harmonises with the surrounding natural beauty. Recreational facilities of international caliber, from water‑sport hubs to curated leisure programs, enrich the everyday experience for residents and visitors alike.

Dubai Islands embraces a diversified lifestyle spectrum, presenting serene residential communities alongside bustling entertainment hubs that celebrate cultural dynamism. Cutting‑edge technologies and green building practices underpin the masterplan, delivering a forward‑thinking habitat that values both comfort and environmental stewardship. This unique combination of natural allure, premium amenities and connectivity positions Dubai Islands as a premier destination for those seeking an unmatched way of life in a city renowned for its ambition.
